quotes.text: Customize the admin menu passcode for your readers.

old_evidence.text: For security, you should set your own custom 5 digit passcode.
Locations that don’t have a custom passcode inherit the account-level default passcode
Only users with Super Administrator, Administrator, Terminal Specialist, or Developer roles can view passcodes.
Stripe applies the new passcode within 10 minutes.
You can specify an admin menu passcode when creating or updating

answers.Q1: For https://docs.stripe.com/terminal/fleet/admin-menu-passcode, the full 2026-11-07 capture states the passcode customization purpose and offers Dashboard and API variants, with no detailed prerequisite, actor or state transition (new raw lines 5-14). The May 1 guide says the smart-reader menu covers Wi-Fi, appearance and diagnostics, recommends setting a secure custom five-digit numeric passcode, and describes account-level defaults and higher-priority location overrides, with account or Stripe fallback. Dashboard Super Administrator, Administrator, Terminal Specialist and Developer roles can view, and only the first three can modify. The authorized Dashboard operator updates and applies changed configuration, and the guide says Stripe applies it within 10 minutes. The API uses Configuration create or update with reader_security[admin_menu_passcode] (old raw lines 8-25, old raw lines 27-48, old raw lines 50-70). source-stripe-terminal-admin-menu-passcode reflects May behavior but compresses timing and roles and does not preserve the wording tension between summary hierarchy and the Dashboard toggle.
